title: Arizona Revised Statutes, Title 23, Chapter 2, Article 8.1 - Earned Paid Sick Time
verified_how: Fetched the Title 23 index, which lists 'Article 8.1: Earned Paid Sick Time' within Chapter 2 (Employment Practices and Working Conditions, ss 23-201 to 23-495.01), in the compilation updated through the 57th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session.
notes: Earned paid sick time comes from the 2016 Fair Wages and Healthy Families Act (Proposition 206). Arizona mandates no paid annual leave or holiday pay; job-protected family leave is federal (FMLA, 29 U.S.C. s 2601 et seq.).
